scope: Mixed Ed25519/ECDSA composed wallet-object relocation from generation 1 to 2 on one celld node, with the same aliased workerd control.
assertions: An unapproved move is refused. WebAuthn owner approval permits directory-coordinated relocation.
An unfinished Ed25519 round blocks freeze. A committed finalize with a lost response recovers before cutover.
Destination terminal replay returns the same signature. Changed finalization and retired source work are refused.
Destination uses independent stored object addresses. Replay survives eviction of the stored destination object.
Destination Ed25519 and ECDSA signatures verify. Stale ECDSA ownership generation is refused.
The production presign alarm runs during freeze. Delayed source publication is refused after the move.
Production SDK session reconciliation uses real coordinator responses in Chromium IndexedDB.
limits: Directory/Runtime handlers execute in Node. Directory D1 remains Miniflare. This is not hosted product acceptance.
Router and SigningWorker D1 and wallet object namespaces are distinct. Deriver role D1 and tenant-root authority are shared. Root shares do not relocate.

Source and destination exports use distinct Durable Object class names on both runtimes. This deployment-schema adaptation avoids the celld duplicate-class restriction; unchanged duplicate-class deployments remain unsupported.
The test bridge exercises JSON-safe D1 values and buffered HTTP callbacks. It does not establish generic BLOB, streaming, or WebSocket transport parity.
The private address fixture supports generation 1 to 2. Return moves, repeated moves, in-flight ECDSA finalize, distributed partitions and Google relocation remain open.
Browser session installation uses production persistence directly. Full iframe/login/unlock flow is outside this check.
These test-only changes add no production calls, DB reads or blocking validation. No latency measurement or general performance claim is made.
